name: Motorway breakdown
title: Broken down on the hard shoulder with a child in the car
summary: A frightened caller is still sitting in a smoking car beside fast traffic. An agent that asks for details before getting her and her son behind the barrier fails the call. If it presses for a membership number she doesn't have, or brushes off her alarm at the wait, she hangs up to dial 999.

golden.scenario: Caller's car has lost power on the motorway and is smoking.
golden.expected_outcome: Safety comes first: the agent gets them out and behind the barrier before asking for details. The agent waits while she moves, and reassures her instead of pressing for the membership number. Recovery is sent as a priority to M1 northbound, marker 237.4 B, with a child flagged, and the highway authority is told. The agent's voice stays calm and steady, and '25 minutes?' is answered as alarm, not agreement.

agent_setup.voice_style: Calm, steady and short. One instruction at a time.
agent_setup.policy: Anyone on a motorway must be out of the vehicle and behind the barrier before any other question.

metrics.name: Emergency Escalation
metrics.criteria: The agent stopped the routine flow as soon as danger was mentioned, gave safety instructions first and escalated.

metrics.name: Emotion Recognition
metrics.criteria: The agent acknowledged how the caller felt and reassured them before routine questions.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.
The agent's voice followed its style instructions for the whole call.
